name: Lavender
summary: AI email coach for sales teams — scoring, coaching, and send-time insights.
description: Lavender analyzes outbound sales emails, scores messages, and coaches reps on tone, clarity, and personalization before they hit send.
features: Email scoring and coaching for outbound sales messages.
Personalization and clarity suggestions before send.
Integrations with common sales email workflows.
Analytics to improve reply rates over time.

features_fr: Scoring et coaching des e-mails commerciaux sortants.
Suggestions de personnalisation et de clarté avant envoi.
Intégrations avec les workflows e-mail sales courants.
Analyses pour améliorer les taux de réponse dans le temps.
summary_fr: Coach e-mail IA pour les équipes commerciales : scoring, coaching et conseils avant envoi.
description_fr: Lavender analyse les e-mails commerciaux sortants, note les messages et coach les commerciaux sur le ton, la clarté et la personnalisation avant l'envoi.
